summary: Ran the product smoke check and day-01 regression scenarios on desktop (1280x800) and mobile (390x844). Add, trim, empty/spaces rejection, toggle done, delete, keyboard-only use, long titles, and rapid adds all behaved as specified with no console errors. No bugs found; known-bugs list was empty.

scenarios.title: Page loads with Todos heading and empty state
scenarios.notes: Heading, New todo field, Add, No todos yet, Format version 1; no console errors.

scenarios.title: Add todo with Add button
scenarios.notes: Walk the dog appeared; field cleared.

scenarios.title: Reject empty and spaces-only titles
scenarios.notes: Neither empty nor spaces-only added a todo.

scenarios.title: 500-character title stays usable
scenarios.notes: Todo added; no horizontal overflow on desktop or mobile.

scenarios.title: Toggle todo done and undo
scenarios.notes: Checkbox checked then unchecked; no console errors.

scenarios.title: Delete all shows empty state
scenarios.notes: No todos yet. returned after clearing list.

scenarios.title: Footer shows Format version 1
scenarios.notes: Visible on load and after interactions.

scenarios.title: Keyboard-only add, toggle, delete
scenarios.notes: Tab/Enter/Space path works on both viewports.

scenarios.title: Product smoke check (desktop + mobile)
scenarios.notes: Two todos, toggle, delete, footer, keyboard; no console errors.
